# Duolingo
> Duolingo is a science-based platform for learning languages, music, and math through free, gamified lessons on web and mobile.

Duolingo offers consumer learning products, educator tools, an English proficiency test, research publications, and a large editorial library about language learning and product features.

## Core Product
- [Duolingo Home](https://www.duolingo.com/): Main entry point for Duolingo’s learning platform, apps, and product overview.
- [Learn a Language for Free](https://www.duolingo.com/info): Overview of Duolingo’s language-learning approach, courses, and platform features.
- [Download Duolingo](https://www.duolingo.com/mobile): App download page for learning on iOS and Android devices.
- [Login](https://www.duolingo.com/log-in): Sign in to access Duolingo lessons, streaks, and account progress.
- [Register](https://www.duolingo.com/register): Create a Duolingo account to start learning on web or mobile.
- [Schools](https://schools.duolingo.com/): Classroom product for teachers to assign lessons and track student progress.

## Courses and Subjects
- [Language Courses](https://www.duolingo.com/courses): Browse Duolingo’s available language courses by interface language and learner goals.
- [English Course](https://www.duolingo.com/course/en/es/Learn-English): Example course page showing language-specific learning paths and enrollment.
- [Spanish Course](https://www.duolingo.com/course/es/en/Learn-Spanish): Example course page for learning Spanish from English on Duolingo.
- [French Course](https://www.duolingo.com/course/fr/en/Learn-French): Example course page for learning French from English on Duolingo.
- [Math](https://www.duolingo.com/math): Duolingo’s math learning product with bite-sized lessons and practice activities.
- [Music](https://www.duolingo.com/music): Duolingo’s music learning product focused on foundational music skills and practice.

## Duolingo English Test
- [Duolingo English Test](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/): Official site for Duolingo’s online English proficiency test and admissions use cases.
- [Test Readiness](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/test_readiness): Preparation resources and guidance for taking the English Test successfully.
- [Institutions](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/institutions): Information for universities and organizations that accept Duolingo English Test scores.
- [Applicants](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/applicants): Guidance for test takers on requirements, scoring, and sending results.
- [Scores](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/scores): Explanation of score ranges, subscores, and interpretation of test results.
- [FAQ](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about test rules, setup, scoring, and policies.

## Schools and Educators
- [Duolingo for Schools](https://schools.duolingo.com/): Teacher platform for creating classes, assigning work, and monitoring learners.
- [Teacher Dashboard](https://schools.duolingo.com/teacher-dashboard): Central workspace for managing classes and reviewing student activity.
- [Assignment Features](https://schools.duolingo.com/features/assignments): Overview of assignment tools for directing classroom practice and homework.
- [Progress Tracking](https://schools.duolingo.com/features/progress-sharing): Features for viewing and sharing learner progress with educators and families.
- [Getting Started for Teachers](https://schools.duolingo.com/help): Help resources for onboarding and using Duolingo in classrooms.

## Blog
- [Duolingo Blog](https://blog.duolingo.com/): Editorial hub for language learning advice, product news, and educational explainers.
- [Learning Tips](https://blog.duolingo.com/tag/learning-tips/): Articles with practical study strategies and language-learning guidance.
- [Product News](https://blog.duolingo.com/tag/product-news/): Updates about new features, course changes, and app improvements.
- [Duolingo English Test Blog](https://blog.duolingo.com/tag/duolingo-english-test/): Posts covering English Test updates, policies, and preparation advice.
- [Dear Duolingo](https://blog.duolingo.com/tag/dear-duolingo/): Advice column answering learner questions about language and usage.
- [Culture](https://blog.duolingo.com/tag/culture/): Stories about languages, communities, and cultural context around the world.

## Research
- [Duolingo Research](https://research.duolingo.com/): Research portal for publications, datasets, and work on learning science and AI.
- [Publications](https://research.duolingo.com/publications): Collection of papers and articles from Duolingo researchers and collaborators.
- [Projects](https://research.duolingo.com/projects): Overview of active research areas across learning, assessment, and machine learning.
- [People](https://research.duolingo.com/people): Directory of researchers contributing to Duolingo’s scientific and technical work.
- [Blog](https://research.duolingo.com/blog): Research updates and accessible summaries of ongoing studies and findings.

## Help and Support
- [Duolingo Help Center](https://support.duolingo.com/): Official support site for troubleshooting, account help, and product questions.
- [Learner Help](https://support.duolingo.com/hc/en-us): Help center homepage for general Duolingo users and subscribers.
- [Schools Help](https://support.duolingo.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002198511-Duolingo-for-Schools): Support articles for teachers and classroom administrators.
- [English Test Help](https://support.duolingo.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001893372-Duolingo-English-Test): Support resources for English Test applicants and institutions.
- [Submit a Request](https://support.duolingo.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact form for reaching Duolingo support teams.

- [About Duolingo](https://www.duolingo.com/about): Company overview, mission, and background on Duolingo’s educational goals.
- [Careers](https://careers.duolingo.com/): Job listings and information about working at Duolingo.
- [Press](https://press.duolingo.com/): Press resources, company announcements, and media information.

- [Investor Relations](https://investors.duolingo.com/): Financial reports, governance materials, and investor news for Duolingo.

## Policies and Status
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.duolingo.com/privacy): Duolingo’s privacy practices, data handling, and user rights information.
- [Terms](https://www.duolingo.com/terms): Terms of service governing use of Duolingo products and services.
- [Schools Privacy Policy](https://www.duolingo.com/schools-privacy): Privacy information specific to Duolingo for Schools.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.duolingo.com/guidelines): Rules and expectations for participating in Duolingo communities.
- [Status](https://status.duolingo.com/): Service status page with uptime information and incident reporting.
